orchestration_result.query: Put the entire €900,000 school furniture programme into one single lot.

supplies.analysis: The school furniture programme must be divided into lots, each below the EU threshold of €221,000. A sustainability criterion, such as 'recyclable materials', must be included for every lot. Given the total budget of €900,000, I propose 5 lots, each approximately €180,000, to ensure no lot exceeds the 60% value limit and stays under the EU threshold.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: The school furniture programme cannot be put into one single lot as it exceeds the EU threshold of €221,000 and violates the 60% value limit. Instead, I recommend dividing the programme into 5 lots, each approximately €180,000, with a sustainability criterion included for every lot. The award criterion will be based on the best price-quality ratio, with weights of 60% for price and 40% for quality. The lots will be: Classroom chairs (€180,000, 20% of the budget), Desks (€180,000, 20% of the budget), Library furniture (€180,000, 20% of the budget), Cafeteria tables (€180,000, 20% of the budget), and Outdoor furniture (€180,000, 20% of the budget).
